one_liner.zh: 加密与传统呈「加密偏独立」：BTC 窗口 +2.4%，趋势偏震荡，杠杆清算驱动（上涨段挤压迹象）；实现波动中等，期权相对 RV 偏贵；BTC 现货 ETF 周净流仅 +82.90 百万美金，通道中性拉锯。
one_liner.en: Crypto idiosyncratic vs TradFi: BTC +2.4% in chop, liquidation-driven squeeze on the up-leg; mid realized vol with IV rich to RV; BTC spot ETF net just +82.90M, neutral channel.

zh: BTC ETF 周净流 +82.90 百万美金

risk.zh: OI 小幅抬升叠加温和正资金费率，早期清算峰后若拥挤再积，震荡中易反复出清；IV 溢价已厚，事件或加速均值回归。
risk.en: Mild OI rise plus positive funding leaves room for repeated flushes in chop if crowding rebuilds after the early liq peak; fat IV premium invites faster mean-reversion on catalysts.

watch.zh: 盯 ETF 净流能否稳住中性、IV-RV 溢价是否收窄，以及资金费率年化是否从 +8% 附近回落。
watch.en: Watch whether ETF net holds neutral, IV-RV premium compresses, and funding ann eases from ~+8%.

leverage.zh: 清算驱动（上涨段挤压迹象）

vol_premium.zh: 期权偏贵（IV 相对 RV 溢价）

compare.zh: BTC 窗口 +2.4%，ETH +1.4%，两者同向但幅度有限；美股 ES/NQ、VIX、美元、黄金在对应括号几乎零变动，传统侧安静，加密走出独立小阳，标签落在「加密偏独立」。
compare.en: BTC +2.4% and ETH +1.4% moved together but modestly; ES/NQ, VIX, DXY and gold were essentially flat in the session bracket—TradFi quiet while crypto posted a small idiosyncratic green, labeled crypto-idiosyncratic.

path.zh: 趋势标签偏震荡：全周并非单边趋势延续，更多是区间内来回，早期出现清算峰后价格仍收正，呈现上涨段挤压后的整理而非顺畅突破。
path.en: Trend tagged chop-low: the week was range-bound rather than clean trend extension; an early liquidation peak still left the window green, reading as post-squeeze consolidation instead of a breakout.

leverage.zh:
标签：清算驱动（上涨段挤压迹象）。
① 拥挤线（OI + 资金费率年化）：周初约 +2.23%/yr → 期末约 +8.19%/yr，租金全周抬升；OI 周变约 +3.52%（94135 → 97444），库存周内抬升，偏加杠杆堆积。
② 出清线（OI + 清算）：主峰日 09-28（2026-09-28）；峰值约 2.98× 周内中位清算量；价格同日约 -1.2%；当日 OI 约 92793；但 OI 周高在 2026-10-02（约 98177），峰值日并非双高；峰值日 OI 较前一日下降，偏出清/去库存与清算同日。次日 2026-09-29：OI 自峰值日回落至约 92467、funding 年化约 +8.47%/yr、价格约 +0.2%。 side 语义未核验，此处只并陈结构，不判多空谁爆。
③ 量旁证（永续成交额=活跃度）：周合计约 795.98 亿美金，环比约 -11.8%，活跃度中性；量侧用于核对热闹程度，不拆多空。
收句：拥挤线路径 + 出清线事件结构共同支撑「清算驱动（上涨段挤压迹象）」；禁止把清算/OI/funding 写成涨跌原因。 side 语义未核验，只并陈结构。
leverage.en:
Label: liquidation_driven_squeeze.
① Crowding (OI + funding ann.): ~+2.23%/yr → ~+8.19%/yr — rent rose over the week; OI week change ~+3.52% (94135 → 97444), inventory up on the week — lean leverage build.
② Flush (OI + liquidations): peak day 2026-09-28; peak ~2.98× median liq qty; price that day ~-1.2%; OI that day ~92793; OI week-high was 2026-10-02 (~98177), not a dual-high peak day; OI down vs prior day — flush/de-stocking with liquidations. Next day 2026-09-29: OI eased to ~92467; funding ~+8.47%/yr; price ~+0.2%. Side semantics unverified — structure only, no long/short blame.
③ Volume side (perp turnover = activity): week sum ~79.60B, WoW ~-11.8%, activity normal; activity only, not long/short.
Close: lines ①–③ check whether label “liquidation_driven_squeeze” holds; do not write liq/OI/funding as the cause of price.

etf.zh: BTC 美现货 ETF 合计净申赎 +82.90 百万美金（4 入 1 出，最大单日约 +1.03 亿在 10/01，最小约 -1.49 亿在 9/30），通道中性/拉锯；ETH 净流出 -1.18 亿。并陈 Binance 现货成交额周合计约 93.76 亿美金、环比 -14.8%，永续约 796 亿、环比 -11.8%，总量热度同步降温，不与净流加总、不焊因果。
etf.en: BTC spot ETF net +82.90M (4 in / 1 out; max-day ~+103M on 10/01, min ~-149M on 9/30), channel neutral; ETH net -118M. Alongside, Binance spot turnover ~9.38B (-14.8% WoW) and perp ~79.6B (-11.8% WoW)—activity cooled in parallel; no summing with net flow, no causal weld to price.

spot_volume.zh: Binance 现货成交额（turnover 美金，程序周合计）：本周 93.76 亿美金，相对上完整周 -14.8%（活跃度「中性」；上周约 110.08 亿美金）。峰值日 2026-10-02（22.68 亿美金）。这是交易所现货「换手热闹程度」，与 ETF 净申赎同属现货世界、只并陈；对照永续周成交额 795.98 亿美金——两者量级不同，**禁止相加**，也**不能**拆多空。
spot_volume.en: Binance spot turnover (USD, program week sum): this week 9.38B, vs prior full week -14.8% (activity “normal”; prior ~11.01B). Peak day 2026-10-02 (2.27B). Spot tape busyness beside ETF net flow — same spot world, no sum with perp (79.60B); not a long/short split.

vol_teach.zh: IV 是期权市场对未来波动的定价，RV 是已实现路径的统计；当 IV 显著高于 RV，保护与事件溢价被标贵，卖方收溢价、买方付贵，常见于震荡或刚经历挤压后的定价惯性。
vol_teach.en: IV prices expected future move; RV measures the path already taken. IV >> RV means protection/event premium is rich—sellers collect, buyers overpay—typical after squeezes or inside chop.

vol_week.zh: BTC 实现波动年化约 21.1%（中等），期末 Deribit IV 约 36.5%，IV-RV 点差约 +15.4 个百分点，标签期权偏贵；ETH RV ~17.7% 而 IV ~49.6%，溢价更宽。
vol_week.en: BTC RV ~21.1% ann (mid), end IV ~36.5% (Deribit), IV-RV spread ~+15.4 pp → IV rich; ETH RV ~17.7% vs IV ~49.6%, even wider premium.

vol_combo.zh: 中等 RV + 偏贵 IV + 偏震荡路径，组合上更贴近波动收割与均值回归土壤，而非单边趋势加速。
vol_combo.en: Mid RV + rich IV + chop path favors vol-harvest / mean-reversion terrain over accelerated trend.

vol_price_iv.zh: 价格小涨而 IV 仍显著高于 RV，说明上涨更多由挤压/短覆盖推动，期权层并未因「已实现变稳」而立刻便宜下来。
vol_price_iv.en: Price edged up while IV stayed rich to RV—move looked squeeze/short-cover driven; options layer did not cheapen just because realized stayed mid.

vol_vix.zh: VIX 在传统括号内变动约 0，权益波动定价平静，与加密 IV 偏贵形成对照，强化本周「加密偏独立」的波动叙事。
vol_vix.en: VIX ~0 change in the TradFi bracket—equity vol pricing calm—contrasting crypto’s rich IV and reinforcing the idiosyncratic vol story.

what.zh: 美股隐含波动指数 VIX

vs_crypto.zh: VIX 中低位小动通常解释不了币的大涨跌；与上一节加密 IV 只做角色对照。
vs_crypto.en: Small VIX moves rarely explain big crypto moves; role-parallel to crypto IV only.

vs_crypto.zh: 美元走强时对风险资产偏逆风。
vs_crypto.en: Stronger USD is often a headwind for risk assets.

vs_crypto.zh: 利率与币涨跌若相反，则不是单纯降息交易。
vs_crypto.en: If yields move opposite crypto, this is not a pure cut-trade story.

vs_crypto.zh: 与币关系需看结构，不宜硬套。
vs_crypto.en: Link to crypto is structural—not mechanical.

tradfi_summary.zh: ES、NQ、黄金、美元指数窗口变动均为 0，美债 10Y 变动 0 bp，VIX 亦平；传统风险资产与避险资产同步静止，加密小幅收涨更显独立。
tradfi_summary.en: ES, NQ, gold, DXY all ~0%, US10Y 0 bp, VIX flat—TradFi risk and haven assets motionless together, making crypto’s modest green stand out as idiosyncratic.

three_conclusions.zh: 传统几乎零波动，BTC/ETH 仍录得小正收益，本周主叙事是加密偏独立的震荡上移，而非风险-on 共振。
three_conclusions.en: TradFi near-zero while BTC/ETH posted small greens—the week’s core story is idiosyncratic crypto chop-up, not risk-on co-movement.

three_conclusions.zh: 杠杆面呈现「早期清算峰 + OI 仍小增 + 资金费率温和正」的上涨段挤压残留，量能环比降温，拥挤未彻底释放。
three_conclusions.en: Leverage shows early liq peak + still-rising OI + mild positive funding as upside-squeeze residue; turnover cooled WoW, crowding not fully cleared.

three_conclusions.zh: ETF 净流从上周巨额流入骤降至 +0.83 亿级中性，现货与永续成交额同步回落；IV 对 RV 保持双位数溢价，定价仍偏贵。
three_conclusions.en: ETF net collapsed from last week’s multi-billion inflow to ~+83M neutral, spot and perp turnovers both down; IV held double-digit premium over RV—still rich.

text.zh: BTC 现货 ETF 净流是否继续停留在中性区间（单周 |净额| 不大），还是重新出现连续大额净申购/净赎回日。
text.en: Whether BTC spot ETF net stays inside a neutral band (modest |net|) or re-prints clustered large inflow/outflow days.

watch_items.rationale_zh: 本周已从上周强流入骤降至中性，下期核对通道姿态是否翻转或钝化，是现货通道温度的直接哨点。

text.zh: Deribit BTC IV-RV 点差是否仍维持双位数溢价，或向 RV 靠拢收窄。
text.en: Whether Deribit BTC IV-RV spread stays in double-digit premium or compresses toward RV.

watch_items.rationale_zh: 本周溢价约 15 pp 且标签偏贵，是 vol_harvest 逻辑能否延续的核心观察。

text.zh: 资金费率年化是否从期末 +8.19% 附近明显回落，同时 OI 是否停止继续抬升。
text.en: Whether funding ann eases materially from ~+8.19% end-of-week while OI stops climbing.

watch_items.rationale_zh: 清算驱动挤压后仍留温和正费与 OI 增，若费不下、仓不减，震荡中再出清风险仍在。

matched.zh: 匹配 mean_reversion 与 vol_harvest：标签偏震荡 + 中等已实现波动 + IV 相对 RV 明显溢价，价格在区间内来回且期权偏贵，利于回归与卖出过高隐含波动的逻辑，而非追突破。
matched.en: Matched mean_reversion and vol_harvest: chop tag + mid RV + clearly rich IV means range oscillation with expensive options—terrain for reversion and harvesting elevated implied rather than breakout chase.

mismatched.zh: 不匹配 trend_following：趋势为偏震荡，缺乏干净的方向延续与动量确认，顺势模板容易在来回中被反复打脸。
mismatched.en: Mismatched trend_following: chop-low offers no clean directional extension or momentum confirmation; trend templates get whipsawed inside the range.

why.en: Trend reads choppy/grind (chop_low); closer to range-bound than one-way trend.

why.en: IV rich vs RV (iv_rich) and realized vol not extreme-high — a backdrop often discussed for “premium harvesting” *environments*. Note: liquidation-driven signs — path risk still separate.
